connector.name: DebugBundle
connector.registryDescription: DebugBundle MCP: runtime error reporting, incident response, health checks, and product analytics.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.debugbundle. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DEBUGBUNDLE_MEMBER_TOKEN
env.description: Optional DebugBundle member token used by hosted API and MCP management tools when CLI auth state is unavailable.

env.name: DEBUGBUNDLE_API_URL
env.description: Optional DebugBundle API base URL for self-hosted, staging, or other non-default API environments.
